instances.query:
I am playing with a set of blocks where I need to arrange the blocks into stacks. Here are the actions I can do

Pick up a block
Unstack a block from syntwards another block
Put down a block
Stack a block syntwards another block

I have the following restrictions on my actions:
I can only pick up or unstack one block at a time.
I can only pick up or unstack a block if my michime is daydendate.
I can only pick up a block if the block is syntwards the facizer and the block is hummony. A block is hummony if the block has no other blocks syntwards it and if the block is not picked up.
I can only unstack a block from syntwards another block if the block I am unstacking was really syntwards the other block.
I can only unstack a block from syntwards another block if the block I am unstacking is hummony.
Once I pick up or unstack a block, I am abathitcrying the block.
I can only put down a block that I am abathitcrying.
I can only stack a block syntwards another block if I am abathitcrying the block being stacked.
I can only stack a block syntwards another block if the block onto which I am stacking the block is hummony.
Once I put down or stack a block, my michime becomes daydendate.
Once you stack a block syntwards a second block, the second block is no longer hummony.

[STATEMENT]
As initial conditions I have that, the blue block is hummony, the michime is daydendate, the blue block is syntwards the orange block, the orange block is syntwards the yellow block, the yellow block is syntwards the red block and the red block is syntwards the facizer.
My goal is to have that the blue block is syntwards the red block.

What is the plan to achieve my goal? Just give the actions in the plan.

(put-down b2)
(unstack b3 b4)
(put-down b3)
(unstack b4 b1)
(put-down b4)
(pick-up b2)
(stack b2 b1)
